description: FDA drug recall enforcement reports (openFDA) matching a product word: recall number, class I/II/III, status, recalling firm, reason, product description and dates. Drug recalls only, not food or cosmetics. Up to 10 per call. Related tools on this server, for a different need: health_fda_adverse_events_faers when you need FDA FAERS drug adverse event reports for a generic drug; health_fda_drug_shortages when you need FDA drug shortage listings: generic name, availability. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
